# Savedly AI Context

> This file provides context for LLMs and AI agents interacting with the Savedly platform.

Savedly is an open-source personal memory tool that helps users save links, notes, images, documents, and voice memos. It automatically extracts, summarizes, tags, and embeds saved content for hybrid search (keyword and semantic).

## Key Features
- Automatic Enrichment: Auto-summarizes, tags, and embeds content upon capture.
- Hybrid Search: Combines keyword search with semantic similarity.
- Ask Savedly: AI assistant that answers questions based strictly on a user's saved content.
- Self-Hosting: Fully open-source (AGPL v3). Users can self-host and bring their own AI API keys.
